```json
 "topology": "Two-stage Miller (NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc nulling)",
 "rationale": "Two gain stages give about 70 dB. A large L=1 NMOS input pair at gm/Id 16 keeps 1 kHz flicker and thermal noise low. Cc=3 pF sets GBW to about 30 MHz. Setting gm7 to about 3x the PM-60 requirement places p2 well above GBW, and Rz cancels the RHP zero. Budget: 10 µA ref + 80 µA tail + 300 µA stage 2 = 390 µA, about 0.7 mW. Headroom: VCM 0.9 V gives a 0.3 V tail node, enough for the tail Vdsat of about 0.15 V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16, 10, 20),       # input pair gm/Id (efficiency, low noise)
    "L1": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # input pair L (flicker area, gain)
    "Itail": (80e-6, 40e-6, 160e-6),
    "I7": (300e-6, 150e-6, 420e-6),
    "Lp": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),       # PMOS mirror / 2nd-stage L
    "gmidp": (9, 6, 12),         # PMOS load & M7 gm/Id (matched -> low systematic offset)
    "Cc": (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 6e-12),
    "rz_k": (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),     # Rz = rz_k / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ln, gmidn = 1.0, 8.0          # NMOS current sources
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]

    # --- devices ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=abs(0.9))  # diode load, |Vds|=|Vgs|
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, It, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, I7, vds=0.9)

    # nulling resistor
    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias diode
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    # tail
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # input pair: vinp -> M1 drives the non-mirror side (out1) => non-inverting overall
    # M2 (vinn) on diode side x; M1 (vinp) on out1. vinp up -> out1 down -> vout up (PMOS CS inverts).
    n.dev("M1", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS mirror load
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # --- analytic predictions ---
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * cl + Cc * cl))
    p_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm))  # LHP zero if Rz > 1/gm7
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_mirror)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) * 0.5 + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * p_mirror)))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    th = 16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise_1k = math.sqrt(th) * 4.0   # rough allowance for flicker at 1 kHz
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "slew": slew}
```
